study.title: BAWSeg: A UAV Multispectral Benchmark for Barley Weed Segmentation
study.short_title: VISA two-stream barley weed mIoU 75.6 weed 63.5

segmentation.domain: Crop (barley) / weed (annual ryegrass) / other 3-class semantic segmentation on radiometrically calibrated five-band UAV orthomosaics with deployment-oriented protocols (within-plot, cross-plot, cross-year); proposes VISA, a two-stream network decoupling radiance cues (raw calibrated reflectance) from vegetation-index cues (NDVI, GNDVI, EVI, SAVI, MSAVI) fused at native 256x256 resolution to be robust to canopy mixing, illumination drift and domain shift
segmentation.best_model: VISA (Vegetation-Index and Spectral Attention): within-plot test mIoU 0.756 +/- 0.004 (block-bootstrap 95% CI), weed IoU 0.635, crop IoU 0.847, other IoU 0.794, micro-F1 0.847, OA 0.946, Cohen's kappa 0.794; +0.012 mIoU / +0.019 weed IoU over strongest baseline SegFormer-B1 MSI (0.744 / 0.616); cross-plot transfer 0.712-0.718 mIoU, cross-year 0.692 +/- 0.007 mIoU (weed 0.544); 22.8 M params, 33.6 GFLOPs @256x256, 78 FPS on RTX 4090 (FP16, batch 1)

dataset.name: BAWSeg: four-year (2020-2023) UAV multispectral benchmark over two commercial barley paddocks (E2, E8; 0.6046 km^2 total) near Kondinin, Western Australia; DJI Phantom 4 Multispectral with RTK positioning (TimeSync) and upward irradiance sensor; 120 m AGL, lawnmower missions, 80% forward/side overlap, nominal GSD approx. 6.35 cm/pixel; radiometrically calibrated five-band reflectance orthomosaics (blue, green, red, red edge, NIR) via panel calibration, Agisoft Metashape orthorectification with RTK geotags; five derived VIs (NDVI, GNDVI, EVI, SAVI, MSAVI); dense QGIS polygon-based pixel annotations (crop / weed / other, weed precedence for mixed canopies, NDVI vegetation-mask-assisted); leakage-free spatial block splits enabling within-plot, cross-plot and cross-year protocols; public preview subset on IEEE DataPort, full dataset released upon publication.
dataset.note: Author-collected benchmark (uav_collected=true). images=null: image count not stated in extracted text; training/eval uses 256x256 patches cropped from georeferenced orthomosaics (sliding-window stride 128 at block evaluation). Nominal GSD 6.35 cm/pixel from manufacturer spec (H/18.9 cm/pixel at 120 m). Annotation: crop=1, weed=2, other=0, ignore=255; class-balanced via median-frequency weighting; very small weeds a few pixels wide near resolution limit are the hardest class. Year-range within-plot mIoU 0.748-0.763, weed IoU >= 0.62 across years.

segmentation.backbone: Dual-stream encoder. SRAB (Spectral Residual Attention Branch): 3-stage residual-attention encoder (widths 64/128/256, squeeze-excitation + CBAM spatial gating, skip-connected decoder) feeding on 5-band reflectance. VIMB (Vegetation-Index Modelling Branch): 5 indices -> 1x1 projection (d=64) + LayerNorm, 2 windowed self-attention layers (window 8, h=8, relative positional bias), 2 Mamba-style state-space blocks (single row-major scan), Slot Attention (K=6, T=3) + mean-slot broadcast, scale-aligned refinement (aux loss weight 0.3). Native-resolution fusion head (3x3 conv + BN + ReLU, 1x1 classifier, temperature-scaled softmax). Loss: class-balanced CE (median-frequency) + soft Dice + Sobel edge loss.

mIoU.quote: Under within-plot evaluation, the model reaches mIoU 0.756 +/- 0.004 with weed IoU 0.635
mIoU.ambiguity: Within-plot protocol (test on held-out blocks, E2 & E8, 2020-2023). By year/field mIoU 0.748-0.763; per-class IoU crop 0.847 / weed 0.635 / other 0.794. Cross-plot 0.712+-0.006 (E2->E8) and 0.718+-0.006 (E8->E2); cross-year 0.692+-0.007 (weed 0.544). Block-bootstrap 95% CIs. Stored best within-plot value.

mPA.ambiguity: Mean pixel accuracy not reported; mIoU, per-class IoU, micro-F1, OA and Cohen's kappa used.

F1.quote: Micro-F1 remains close to 0.84, while OA remains close to 0.95 and kappa remains close to 0.79
F1.ambiguity: Micro-averaged F1 (summed confusion counts across all classes and blocks), within-plot protocol = 0.847 (Table 2); by year/field 0.842-0.852 (Table 1). Cross-plot 0.834/0.839; cross-year 0.822.

Dice.ambiguity: Soft Dice used only as a training-loss component, not reported as an evaluation metric.

PA.ambiguity: Overall accuracy (OA), within-plot protocol (Table 2). Per year/field OA 0.943-0.948 (Table 1). Cross-plot OA 0.937/0.939; cross-year OA 0.936. Strong class imbalance (vegetation vs rare weed pixels) keeps OA high.

weed_F1.ambiguity: Per-class F1 not reported; per-class weed IoU reported instead (0.635 within-plot, 0.576/0.584 cross-plot, 0.544 cross-year).

crop_F1.ambiguity: Per-class crop F1 not reported; crop IoU 0.847 (within-plot), 0.832-0.846 under transfer protocols.

edge.device: None - post-flight workstation deployment only: single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (24 GB) workstation (AMD Ryzen 9 7950X, 32 GB RAM, Ubuntu 22.04.4 LTS). Authors explicitly state the system is 'more suitable for reliable offline decision support than for direct onboard UAV inference'.
edge.precision: FP16 (inference measured at FP16 batch 1; evaluation FP32; training automatic mixed precision)
edge.framework: PyTorch 2.7 / CUDA 12.6 / Python 3.10; AdamW lr 6e-4 cosine decay after 1500-iter warmup; 50 epochs, batch 16, 256x256 patches; class-balanced CE + soft Dice + edge objective; deterministic seeds (2026)

fps.quote: The full model uses 22.8 M parameters, 33.6 GFLOPs, 2.60 GB FP16 memory, and runs at 78 FPS for 256 x 256 patches on a single RTX 4090
fps.ambiguity: edge.reported=false: measured on an RTX 4090 workstation (batch size 1, FP16, 256x256, 20 warm-up + 200 timed iterations, torch.cuda.synchronize), i.e., post-flight workstation processing, NOT embedded/onboard. Ablation FPS: w/o VIMB 92, w/o relative bias 78, w/o SlotAttention 80, h=12 74, Mamba L=3 75.

latency_ms.quote: runs at 78 FPS for 256 x 256 patches on a single RTX 4090
latency_ms.ambiguity: Derived as 1000/78 from the reported RTX 4090 FPS; paper reports FPS only. edge.reported=false (workstation, not edge).

params_M.quote: The proposed two-stream fusion achieves mIoU 0.756 +/- 0.004 and weed IoU 0.635 with 22.8M parameters
params_M.ambiguity: Structural param count of full VISA model; ablation: w/o VIMB 9.6, heads/variants 12.3-13.1 M. Not an edge deployment.

gflops.quote: The full model uses 22.8 M parameters, 33.6 GFLOPs, 2.60 GB FP16 memory
gflops.ambiguity: Measured with fvcore at 256x256 input (MACs counted as FLOPs), eval mode. Ablations: 25.4-34.9 GFLOPs. Not an edge deployment.

issues: VENUE MISMATCH: worklist lists 'arXiv Preprint' but the verified full text is the MDPI Remote Sensing article (Remote Sens. 2026, 18, 915, DOI 10.3390/rs18060915, published 17 March 2026). Venue field keeps the worklist value; all metrics from the verified extracted_md.
edge.reported=false: throughput (78 FPS) measured on an RTX 4090 workstation; the paper explicitly positions the system for post-flight offline decision support, not onboard UAV inference.
uav_collected=true: authors built the BAWSeg benchmark themselves (DJI Phantom 4 Multispectral, RTK + irradiance).
F1 is micro-averaged (summed confusion counts over classes); per-class F1 not reported (per-class IoU is the reported per-class metric).
Reported best metric stored for the within-plot protocol (deployment-oriented cross-plot/cross-year values lower).
